answer.title: Daily Customer Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggered every working day at 16:00 to prepare daily reminder calls.
steps: Identify today's appointments or tasks needing a reminder.
Draft personalized reminder scripts or messages for each customer.
Queue the reminder notifications or call list for the phone system.
Log completed reminder attempts in the system.
answer.ai_help: AI drafts the reminder messages based on customer appointment details.
answer.human_approval: Claire reviews the call list before automated reminders are sent.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes would only result in incorrect reminder timing or slightly annoying customers, with no financial loss.
